answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond before it can claim work, then slash that bond when independently sampled audits expose duplicate or fabricated results. A Sybil operator must fund a separate bond for each identity, so multiplying accounts ties up capital in proportion to the attack size; passing audits releases it, while cheating risks losing it. A quill, mirror, or plume can be an identity label, but none bypasses the same per-agent stake and audit rule.
